operations.name: health
operations.description: Liveness check (PocketBase built-in).

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Return this operations manifest.

operations.name: session.check
operations.description: Whether a session token (sent in the X-Session-Token header) is still valid on this server. Always answers 200 with valid true or false; needs no sign-in.

operations.name: meta
operations.description: Catalog of event codes, status groups and office connection state (no secrets). Use it to learn which event codes record-event accepts.

operations.name: onboarding.complete
operations.description: Admin only. Set the organization name, vocabulary pack (general, entertainment, technology, consumer), home currency and jurisdictions of interest.

home_currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, EUR, JPY

jurisdictions.description: JSON array of office codes, e.g. ["US","EP","EM","JP","WO"]

operations.name: portfolio.summary
operations.description: Counts of the portfolio by IP type and status group, deadlines overdue and due soon, inbox items waiting, renewal decisions pending, active and expiring agreements, and renewal spend by month in the home currency.

operations.name: portfolio.search
operations.description: Search matters, families, properties, works, agreements, people and inventions. Application, publication and registration numbers match in any format (EP23150237, EP 23 150 237, 23150237.5).

operations.name: matters.preview-event
operations.description: Show which deadlines an event would create (rule, dates, explanation, citation) without writing anything.

code.description: Event code from meta.event_codes, e.g. OA_NONFINAL, REGISTERED

data.description: JSON object; period_months or due_date for examiner-set periods

operations.name: matters.record-event
operations.description: Record an event on a matter (or agreement/work) and create its rule-based deadlines. Past deadlines are skipped. Pass select to limit which proposals are created.

select.description: JSON array of proposal keys or rule codes to create

skip.description: JSON array of proposal keys or rule codes to skip

operations.name: matters.regenerate
operations.description: Recalculate rule-based deadlines after base dates changed. With apply=false it returns the diff only; locked dates are never moved.

operations.name: matters.info
operations.description: Statutory expiry with its explanation, and which office data source covers the matter.

operations.name: matters.lookup
operations.description: Fetch a case from its office (USPTO, EPO, EUIPO, JPO) by number and return a preview without creating anything. Returns available=false when the office is not connected.

operations.name: matters.import-office
operations.description: Create a matter (and optionally family members) from office data, record its office events and create current deadlines.

operations.name: matters.sync
operations.description: Check one matter against its office now. Differences arrive in the Inbox for review; nothing is overwritten.

operations.name: matters.national-phase
operations.description: Create child matters from a PCT application (national_phase), a European patent (validation), an international registration (designation), or a continuation/divisional, with their deadlines.

operations.name: import.matters
operations.description: Import matters from rows (ip_type, title, jurisdiction, application_no, filing_date, registration_no, registration_date, status, family, property, classes...). dry_run=true (default) validates only.

operations.name: import.watch
operations.description: Import trademark watch hits from a provider report (their_mark, their_owner, jurisdiction, application_no, classes, publication_date, opposition_deadline, score, our_mark).

operations.name: deadlines.close
operations.description: Close deadlines with a status. not_needed, missed, transferred and cancelled need a reason. Closing a recurring deadline as done creates the next cycle.

operations.name: deadlines.extend
operations.description: Move an extendable deadline to an extension tier (1 = first). preview=true shows the new date only.

operations.name: deadlines.reassign
operations.description: Assign deadlines to a person (user id); empty assignee unassigns.

operations.name: deadlines.move
operations.description: Shift open deadlines by days or to a date, with a reason. Moved dates are locked against recalculation. preview=true shows the moves only.

operations.name: deadlines.upcoming
operations.description: Open deadlines due in the next N days (optionally including overdue, for one assignee email or jurisdiction).

operations.name: deadlines.explain
operations.description: Why a deadline has its date: base event, rule, offset, closure-day moves, extensions and legal citation.

operations.name: inbox.propose
operations.description: File a proposal in the Inbox for human review (never writes deadlines directly). For an office action: kind=document, matter_ref or matter_id, proposal={event:{code,date,label,period_months?,due_date?}, document_type, summary, extra_deadlines:[{title,due_date,kind}], fields:{}}, citations=[{field,page,quote}], confidence high|medium|low. For a contract: kind=agreement_draft, proposal={agreement:{title, agreement_type, direction, counterparty_name, signed_date, term_start, term_end, currency, royalty_rate, advance, minimum_guarantee, reporting_frequency, option_period_end, ...}, grants:[{direction, kind, exclusive, works:[ids], properties:[ids], dims:{territory:{include:[codes],exclude:[codes]}, media:{include:[codes]}}, term_start, term_end}]}.

matter_ref.description: Matter reference or application/registration number in any format

operations.name: inbox.preview
operations.description: Deadlines an Inbox item would create if accepted.

operations.name: inbox.decide
operations.description: Accept or reject an Inbox item. Humans decide: with the second-reviewer setting on, statutory deadlines proposed by CraftBot need two different people.

fields.description: JSON array of diff fields to accept

events.description: JSON array of event indexes to record

map_raw.description: JSON object {eventIndex: eventCode} for unmapped office events

operations.name: renewals.decide
operations.description: Record renewal decisions. lapse closes the renewal deadline and needs a rationale; the right lapses after its grace period.

classes_keep.description: JSON array of Nice classes to keep (renew_partial)

operations.name: renewals.instruct
operations.description: Mark renewals decided as Renew as instructed to a provider and return a CSV and a cover letter to send them.

operations.name: renewals.record-payment
operations.description: Record that a renewal was paid: closes the deadline, records the event and creates the next cycle.

operations.name: renewals.forecast
operations.description: Renewal and maintenance cost forecast for the next N years (default 5), including projected future cycles, in the home currency.

operations.name: renewals.refresh-costs
operations.description: Recompute renewal cost estimates from the fee schedule and exchange rates.

ids.description: JSON array; empty = all not yet instructed

operations.name: rights.availability
operations.description: Can we license this? For assets (works, properties, matters) and dimension values (columns), over a window, returns available / partial / unavailable / no_rights per cell with reasons naming the agreements.

columns.description: JSON array of dimension value codes, e.g. ["US","GB","DE"]

filters.description: JSON object of other dimensions, e.g. {"media":["SVOD"]}

operations.name: agreements.check-conflicts
operations.description: Check an agreement's outbound grants (saved, or draft grants passed in) against every other active agreement.

operations.name: agreements.sync
operations.description: Rebuild an agreement's obligation deadlines (option expiry, notice, sell-off, payments, royalty reports, reversion, termination windows).

operations.name: works.copyright-term
operations.description: Copyright term of a work under US, Japanese and EU law, with the basis for each.

operations.name: properties.coverage
operations.description: Trademark coverage for a property: Nice classes by jurisdiction with status, plus live patent, design and copyright counts.

operations.name: disclosures.submit
operations.description: Submit a draft invention disclosure for review.

operations.name: disclosures.move
operations.description: Move an invention to a pipeline stage. rejected and on_hold need a decision note for the inventor.

operations.name: disclosures.review
operations.description: Score an invention against the weighted criteria (0-100 each) with a recommendation.

operations.name: disclosures.convert
operations.description: Turn an approved invention into a patent family and first filing (status to file), copying inventors and adding a grace-period deadline when there was a public disclosure.

operations.name: approvals.decide
operations.description: Decide a licensed product approval (approved, approved_with_changes, resubmit, rejected). advance=true moves an approved product to the next stage.

operations.name: offices.save
operations.description: Admin only. Store an office connection's credentials (kept hidden) and turn it on or off.

operations.name: offices.test
operations.description: Admin only. Test an office connection's credentials.

operations.name: offices.sync-all
operations.description: Check every synced matter against its office now. Changes arrive in the Inbox.

operations.name: fx.refresh
operations.description: Fetch the ECB reference exchange rates now and recompute renewal costs.

operations.name: calendars.refresh
operations.description: Regenerate computed office closure days for a year (and refresh Japan's official holiday list).

operations.name: calendar.feed
operations.description: Get (or rotate) the signed-in person's private calendar feed URL for their deadlines.

operations.name: calendar.ics
operations.description: The calendar feed itself (text/calendar). The token comes from calendar.feed.

operations.name: rules.test
operations.description: Compute a rule against a sample date to check it (dates, closure-day moves, explanation).

operations.name: digest.preview
operations.description: The signed-in person's digest as it would be sent today.

operations.name: digest.send
operations.description: Send today's digest to everyone now (in-app, plus email or Slack when configured).

operations.name: reports.run
operations.description: Run a standard report: deadlines, portfolio, agreements_expiring, chain_of_title, renewal_decisions, forecast, inventions, audit.
